Description
 This organization specializes in developing advanced software solutions tailored for the retail sector. It provides innovative platforms that empower businesses to optimize their operations, enhance customer engagement, and drive digital transformation. The focus is on creating robust, scalable applications that address the complex challenges faced by modern retailers. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, the company helps its clients streamline processes and deliver superior experiences. Its offerings support a diverse range of retail segments, from large enterprises to specialized brands. The aim is to enable retailers to adapt to evolving market demands and achieve sustained growth.
 Requirements
Possessing 5-8 years of progressive experience in DevOps engineering, demonstrating a strong track record of designing, implementing, and managing scalable cloud infrastructure and automated deployment pipelines.
This position offers a fully remote work model, providing the flexibility to collaborate effectively with global teams from any location within the specified regions.
 Required Skills:
Demonstrated advanced expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS), including comprehensive knowledge of core services and best practices for cloud architecture and operations.
Proven advanced proficiency in Kubernetes for container orchestration, including deployment, management, and scaling of containerized applications.
Solid intermediate experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code, capable of provisioning, managing, and versioning cloud resources effectively.
Advanced hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, encompassing image creation, container lifecycle management, and deployment strategies.
Extensive advanced experience with various CI/CD tools, designing and implementing robust automated pipelines for continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Advanced proficiency in Git for version control, including complex branching strategies, repository management, and collaborative development workflows.
Intermediate capability in PowerShell scripting, enabling automation of tasks and management of Windows-based systems within a DevOps environment.
Intermediate proficiency in Bash scripting, utilized for automating operational tasks, system administration, and pipeline execution in Linux environments.
 Preferred Skills:
Familiarity with Ansible at an intermediate level, applying automation for configuration management and application deployment across diverse environments.
Experience with Jenkins at an intermediate level, contributing to the setup and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and job configurations.
Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at an intermediate level, understanding its core services and potential for multi-cloud strategies.
Advanced understanding and practical experience with Microsoft Azure services, contributing to hybrid cloud solutions and deployments.
 Job responsibilities
Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure solutions primarily on AWS, leveraging advanced services.
Develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery across environments.
Manage and optimize container orchestration platforms using Kubernetes, ensuring high availability and performance of applications.
Utilize Terraform for infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision, manage, and update cloud resources consistently.
Implement and manage Docker containers for application packaging and deployment, ensuring immutability and portability.
Develop and maintain scripting solutions using Bash and PowerShell to automate operational tasks and system configurations.
Ensure the security, reliability, and performance of cloud environments through proactive monitoring and incident response.
Collaborate with development teams to integrate DevOps practices early in the software development lifecycle.
Contribute to the architectural design and evolution of cloud infrastructure and deployment strategies.
Mentor junior engineers on best practices for cloud operations, automation, and infrastructure management.
Evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the DevOps ecosystem and improve operational efficiency.
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, providing timely resolution and root cause analysis.
Establish and enforce best practices for version control using Git, including branching strategies and code reviews.
